batting.name: KS Bharat
batting.dismissal: c VR Iyer b SP Narine

batting.name: GJ Maxwell
batting.dismissal: c LH Ferguson b SP Narine

batting.name: Shahbaz Ahmed
batting.dismissal: c Shivam Mavi b LH Ferguson

batting.name: Shubman Gill
batting.dismissal: c AB de Villiers b HV Patel

batting.name: VR Iyer
batting.dismissal: c KS Bharat b HV Patel

batting.name: N Rana
batting.dismissal: c AB de Villiers b YS Chahal

batting.name: KD Karthik
batting.dismissal: c KS Bharat b Mohammed Siraj

balls.text: dances down, and misses his slog to this very full ball outside off. They scamper for a bye, as Karthik misses his throw at his end
yorker length ball outside off, and swung away to deep midwicket away from his body. A quick two is gobbled safely this time
very full and wide of off, and given wide after he lets that go

run-out at the bowler's end! Never run on a misfield they say, as Ferguson fumbles at square leg and the batters get involved in a mix-up in search of the second. But Christian was far too short when the throw came in after Harshal tried to scoop that full-toss wide of off, and was always ready to go for the second the moment he saw the misfield. There was a bit of a yes-no in the middle of the pitch, after which Harshal ran at the keeper's end, resulting in Christian falling short

slow, dipping full-toss, and he appeals for leg before as the ball hits Harshal's pads! Given out, but the batter reviews. Harshal is standing deep in his crease, and swings full stretch to this ball dying on him. But the ball hits his back thigh in and around off stump instead. But UltraEdge confirms there is a little invisible spike on that off the bat, with the ball taking the bottom of it.
skips down, and slashes to deep point! Opens the bat face to this full-toss outside off, and hammered that away from his body after playing slightly from middle and leg
goes way across off, but can only pop that full ball wide of off to long-on after playing like a half-volley. And it is a no-ball
full-toss on off - perhaps after missing his yorker - and drilled to long-off from deep in his crease

skies that to deep midwicket! A lowish full-toss on middle, and angling in. Shahbaz was standing outside leg, and went for the heave to the on side, but seemed to have got that from the bottom half of the bat. Mavi at the boundary remained unfazed by a team-mate of his running toward him from his right, and completed a calm take in the end
gets an inside edge to his hoick, as Ferguson bowls slightly back of a length on off.  A single behind to short fine leg
goes slashing to this full ball outside off, but finds the man at extra cover, who throws at the keeper's end, but wide of the stumps
drags this full ball on middle to the man at mid-off, and sets off for a rapid run
firm loft, and goes inside out over extra cover for four! There was a lot more pace on this full ball outside off, and he simply lifted that with high elbows
that was in the slot and outside off, but a slower ball - in fact nearly a legcutter. Christian swings his bat to try and slog that to the leg side, but is beaten
nails this yorker on middle and leg. Shahbaz is again standing outside leg, before drilling that off the inside half of the bat to deep square leg for a couple
skips forward a touch before gently driving that full ball outside off to long-off with the full face of the bat
and change of pace now. Good length on middle, as Shahbaz backs away to dab that toward deep point
takes a slight step across off, and pushes that full ball off to long-on with the closed face of the bat
looks to flash at that short and wide ball outside off, but is beaten while playing without any foot movement and away from himself
slower ball, and full and wide of off. Dragged to deep point away from his body
fuller and a touch wide of off. He goes for the drive, but gets an inside edge toward short fine leg for a single. That is some spell from Narine, who ends with 4 for 21
leading edge, and nearly another! Goes for the clip to this good length ball on off, but lobs it back instead
there's the fourth! Narine turning it on. Full on middle. Maxwell looks for the slog sweep. Sharp turn in, sliced in the air, and the ball is spiraling towards short third man. Ferguson under it
full outside off, and the reverse sweep finds Rana at cover. Poor timing
full on off. Turning into leg. Maxwell looks for the reverse slap but misses out completely

dropped by Gill! Looked too casual. And he's put it down. Full on off, and the slog sweep is mistimed. Gill runs around at cow corner to lap a simple catch up but doesn't keep his eyes on the ball. Narine denied a fourth
full and wide. Throws his bat at this to drive. Goes to deep point
full and wide outside off. Slaps a shot to extra cover
good length on off. Flicked to midwicket for one

tossed up on off. Tries to play the reverse sweep, but misses. Hits the pad and rolls away to the leg side. They scurry across for one but Varun appeals for lbw. Umpire says out but Shahbaz reviews. Under edge so Shahbaz survives. And since the umpire raised his finger before the single was completed, that goes down as a dot
full on leg. Looks to work it leg side but the ball takes a leading edge to cover's left
good length outside off. Turning away. Tries to cut, but bottom-edged onto the deck
full just outside off. Sharp turn in. Looks to cut but mistimed. Rolls away to backward point
full on middle. Turning in, hits the front pad. But this is going down leg. Maxwell deceived by the turning delivery
full on off. Presses forward and works it to midwicket for a single
through the keeper-first slip gap! Full outside off. Turning in. He looks to fend, but the outside edge goes past DK's pad for four
around the stumps. Good length on middle, and sliding down leg. Tries to flick, past the bat, and they appeal for caught-behind. Not given

another beauty! Narine bowled Kohli. Narine bowled de Villiers. Big player has turned up on the big day. Its the flicker that he releases. Full on off. Slow in the air. de Villiers looks to defend, but there's a tiny gap between bat and pad. Turns in, goes through the space, and the bails have lit up once again!
good length on off. Turning in. Flicked to deep midwicket, and they go around to stop two
quicker ball. Length on off. Flicked to deep midwicket
overpitched again. Wide ball, but inside the tramlines! Dot ball with AB offering no shot

top work from Tripathi! Saves two. Full just outside off. AB goes low and sweeps between deep backward square leg and deep midwicket. Tripathi and Mavi congregating, and the former dives to parry the ball back into the field of play
length bal on off. Turning in. Maxwell moves to the leg side, makes room, and then slogs with the turn to deep midwicket
overpitched outside off. Comes down the ground and strikes the full toss to long on
overpitches outside off stump. Driven to long off for a single as it ends up as a full toss
reverse swept past point! Full on off. de Villiers changes direction, and gets enough bat to play it past point
lbw appeal as this turns in sharply. Full outside off, looks to defend, but the offbreak hits the front pad. Impact outside off, probably
good length just outside off. Nudged off the back foot to deep point for a single
one slip for de Villiers. Good length outside off, and cut to deep point for a single

how beautiful is that ball. Full on middle. Kohli gets low to pay the slog sweep. But Narine delivers this slower through the air. Kohli goes for the slog sweep, but it goes under the bat and crashes into leg stump. Kohli gone after a strike-rate of under 120.
good length on off. Turning in. Maxi goes deep in his crease to pull but the ball stays low and is inside-edged onto his pad. He was out lbw if it was pad first
classic Kohli! Its that flick Kohli is associated with. Length ball on off. Angling in, and he checks the flick beautifuly to deep midwicket
quicker ball. Good length outside off. Kohli comes down the ground and tries to slap it over cover. Misses, and DK takes it near his chest.
good length ball on off. But ball stays low. Maxwell has to adjust his shot choice, ends up clipping it to fine leg for another single
good length ball angling in. Kohli whips it off his waist to deep backward square leg for one
full just outside off, and worked off his pads to midwicket
ball stays low as it hits Maxwell's pads. But big appeal given not out. Length ball outside off but angling in. This would've gone down the leg side, and they choose not to review
full on leg, and angling down the leg side. Maxwell flicks but the team gets a wide run
full on leg. An expansive sweep, only to Ferguson at deep backward square leg
fullish just outside off. Cut to cover point for a single
full just outside leg stump. Clipped to midwicket for a quick run
reverse sweep Full on leg stump, but innovates and slaps it over point for four!
full outside leg stump. Comes down the ground and slogs to deep midwicket
full on middle, and flicked to midwicket. Nobody there so Shakib has to run across and stop
full on middle. Defended to cover. Wants one, but with Morgan lurking at cover they don't
one slip for Maxwell. Full ball on off, and turning away. Maxwell taps it to cover point with soft hands to get off the mark

full, wider outside off. Bharat finally goes for the big shot, but he doesn't have the power to get it over long off. Iyer runs around to get it, and Bharat falls after a 16-ball 9! The carrom ball turning away, and Narine gives out a tiny smile after the dismissal
good length outside off. Nudges it to short third man, and calls early for the run
full outside off. Down on one knee, and slog swept to deep midwicket
full on middle, and flicked to deep backward square leg for a single
full just outside off, and Kohli slaps a drive to wide long off for a single. Shakib's economy is 5 after three overs.
full on leg. Bharat moves to the off side and flicksn to deep square leg
full and wide and sliding further away. Maybe he thought Bharat was going to come down the ground and therefore the attempt at a stumping by going wide.
full outside leg. Kohli nurdles a flick through the midwicket gap to Tripathi in the deep
full on off and sliding further away. Muscles a mistimed drive to deep extra cover
over the stumps, Shakib. Good length on leg. Mistimed punch back to the bowler. Shakib dives to his right
full on off, and the offbreak is clipped to deep midwicket again. Just five
full outside off stump, and slog sweep is inside edged onto his own body
full outside off stump, and whipped to square leg for a single
stumping chance! But DK fluffs it. Good length outside off and turning in. Bharat comes down the ground to slog. Ball zips through the bat-body gap, and DK can't grab it!
full outside off. Driven away from his body to deep point for one
full on off, and clipped off the front foot. Deep midwicket is there
good length on off. Ball stays low, and he bunts one muscled shot down the ground to long off. Tidy Shakib over
leading edge falls just wide of Morgan at cover. Full ball on off. Goes onto the back foot and tries to flick cross-batted. Ball goes the other direction
full on middle, and driven to long on for a single

run out? They're going upstairs. Full on middle, and nudged to short midwicket. Midwicket races in, picks up and throws underhand. DK collects, takes the bails off, but Kohli had returned. Lockie with the effort
mistimed over Kohli. Lands safely at mid on. Shakib goes slow in the air. Full outside off, and Bharat is driving too early. Chipped and safe before long on can run in
around the stumps. Full outside off, and he hits a beautiful cover drive after coming down the ground. Fielded by Morgan at cover, running to his right and diving to intercept
not as full as he would like for a drive. Skips down the ground and drives on the up to deep point. Time out
change of pace. Full outside off. Drives through too early, and he toe-ends a drive to cover point
full on middle, and whipped to deep midwicket for a single
good length ball angling in, and clipped off his waist to deep square leg for one
over the stumps. Good length just outside off and angling in. Fended off the back foot

chopped on! Full and wide outside off from around the stumps. Padikkal sees the length and goes for the drive. But the ball has been inside-edged onto the stumps. A big fist pump from Lockie, and Padikkal walks back looking down
fullish, on leg. Opens the bat's face and runs this shot to deep point
full toss, wider outside off. Driven to cover. Attempted the slower ball, but Kohli pressed forward to meet the delivery before it landed
full on middle. He moves to the leg side to make room. Slapped to mid off for one
slower ball. Full, and very wide outside leg. No shot offered

more runs! Length ball outside leg, and Padikkal looks to flick. Misses the connection, but the ball hits his thigh and goes past the keeper. 141+kph delivery, so that was always going to be four once it beat DK
full just outside off. Soft-hand tap to mid off's left for one

good length ball on off and angling into leg. Kohli moves to the leg side of the ball, shows all three stumps, and then simply lifts a gentle drive over cover. Tripathi runs, runs, and runs... and despite a dive to- stop that's four
full on middle, and he opens the bat's face to push a shot between the cover and cover point gap. Morgan runs, slides around the ball, and throws it back in
wayward and pays the price! Over 147kph, length ball outside leg stump. Clipped fine off his hips with ease for another boundary in the over
full just outside off. Nudged to the left of midwicket, and off they go for another one
full on middle, and pushed gently to mid off. Mavi attacks, picks up, and has a shy, but it's not a direct hit
full on middle, and its a bit of a sloggy shot across the line. Finds midwicket
short ball, but doesn't bounce as much. Padikkal sees the ball angling across, and then cuts it smartly over short third man!

full on leg. Looks to whip an inside out drive through the gap between cover and mid off. But Iyer runs to his right from mid off, and dives to stop the ball. Saves three runs. You could hear DK shouting "dive, Venky!"
full on of. Turning in, and worked off his toes to deep midwicket for one
full on leg stump. Struck to mid off, and they're off for a single. Iyer throws, and very nearly takes the head of Padikkal as he tries to complete the run. Padikkal has to duck!
quicker ball. Length delivery outside off and he stands tall to punch it smartly through the cover-cover point gap. Shakib gives the ball a chase

over the stumps to Kohli. Full just outside off stump, and pushed to cover. Tapped with soft hands to cover for one. The fielder is on the circle line and therefore the single is always available for Kohli
around the stumps. Full just outside off, and he tries to defend. But edged to short third man. They're off for one, and Padikkal is safe at the non-striker's end despite a top throw
its a full toss. Wide outside off and Kohli throws his bat at this. Sliced behind point, and dribbles away for four. Mavi goes from 1 in 5 balls to 10 in 6.

Kohli ruins another good over! Mavi to blame as he goes full and wide. Kohli presses forward and drives it over cover with ease. And as the ball hits the boundary rope, the siren goes off simultaneously. Overstepped, so no ball, and now a free hit
good length outside off. Kohli pokes at it, and on purpose plays it to short third man. Iyer runs across to intercept
full and slightly wide outside off. Kohli stretches forward and swipes a shot to mid on
fuller, on middle, and Padikkal opens the bat's face to defend to cover. They are off for one
good length ball on leg stump, and clipped to square leg. Wants one, but too close to the fielder
full on leg, and defended off the front foot. Mavi collects on the way back
quick feet! Length ball on middle, and angling down leg. Kohli shuffles, puts the back leg right near the stumps, and pulls behind square with the bent knee to square leg. Four to end the over
slower through the air. Full on off and skidding in. Pushed off the back foot to Morgan at midwicket
around the stumps again. Fullish outside off. Sliding into Kohli. He backs away and cuts in front of square
good length just outside off. Bit of turn away. Tapped down the ground to long on
around the stumps to VK. Full on middle, and he presses forward to drive down the ground. Bit of a mistimed shot to long on
over the stumps. Length ball outside off. Turning in, and punched off the back foot to long on for a single
jams that yorker just outside off, as the ball hits him after dropping close to off. They scamper for a single, and Royal Challengers are now eliminated as Knight Riders make the Qualifier 2
dabs at this good length ball on off, and plays to point. A rapid single is gobbled, with the fielder there not collecting cleanly
skips down, but gets a bottom edge behind the wicket to short fine leg. Bharat gives the chase to his right
scoops over short fine leg, and four! Steps across off stump early, and lobs that slower ball on a full length wide of off. Just helped that over the man inside the circle
dot ball again! Short delivery outside off, and now Morgan misses his pull. Seven to win for Knight Riders in the last over
goes for the hoick to this full ball on off, and turns that away to fine leg
slower ball on a shortish length on off, and angling in. Dabbed to third man close from to his body
beaten on the cut! Looks to slash at that shortish ball wide of off, but doesn't get a bat. Precious dot for Royal Challengers
near yorker on middle, and angling in. Flicked to deep square leg, who runs across to his left to stop that. But two quick runs still
flicks this full ball on middle an off to fine leg
back of a length outside off, and dabbed to point. The man there stops after going low to his right, and thus ends an over with two wickets and three runs
full delivery on middle and off, and he opens the bat face to run that down to deep point with a slightly open face of the bat

carried to Bharat? Yes, he thinks so. Karthik has started walking back already though, but the umpire goes upstairs. Good length ball outside off, and angling in. Karthik looks to half-cut-half-drive at that, but gets a faint outside edge off the bottom off the bat. The ball is dying to Bharat, who goes low to try and pouch that. Remember, there is no soft signal in IPL, so the call is to be entirely made by the third umpire. The TV umpire is not satisfied with the angles so far, and so we wait for more replays. Now he says he can see "fingers underneath", and Karthik has finally disappeared into the pavilion
lands a near yorker on off, and that is clipped to mid-on. An overthrow from Maxwell at the bowler's end, and that means a single is stolen

bowled him! Siraj leaps in the air, as he adds a touch of excitement to this. The off stump is pushed back, as Siraj bowls on a good length on off, and with a scrambled seam. Narine stands outside leg and prepares to slog that to the on side, but misses his heave. Some late drama here then?
full delivery on middle, and angling into his pads. Clipped to deep square leg
slower ball, full and wide. Nudged to third man as Harshal finishes with 2/19
slower ball. Just outside off. Defended with very soft hands. Ball ricochets onto his pads off the edge
slower ball. Full outside leg. Tries to slog leg side, but it hits his thigh and rolls away to short fine leg
yorker length, on leg stump. Dug away to midwicket
full on off, and flicked past midwicket to wide long on

There's the record! Oh dear, Patel can't get his 33rd wicket as Padikkal drops it at mid on. Full on leg, slower ball, tries to hit it over the on-side but slices it. Padikkal runs to mid on from midwicket, but it pops out. Harshal still tied on 32 wickets - tied-first with DJ Bravo for the most in one season
good length ball angling in from around off. Slogs uppishly off the back foot. Falls well in short of Ahmed at deep midwicket
good length, on middle. Rocks back and pulls to deep midwicket for a single
good length, on off. Swiped to deep midwicket for a single
full on middle, and clipped to square leg
good length on middle. Looks to slog a pull behind square. Bottom-edged onto the deck
over the infield! Maxwell goes around the stumps. Tries to cramp him with a length ball. But DK shuffles to the leg side and then cuts it over Padikkal at cover point
good length on off. Turning in, and a whippy flick to deep midwicket. Only two off the over and that's the final time out.
full outside off. DK moves to the leg side even before the ball is bowled. Looks to cut but bottom-edged onto the deck
full on off stump. Moves to the leg side and defends it back
full on leg stump, and pushed to cover's left. Vacant spot, so one to Narine

taken at long on and Chahal gets the wicket. Full on middle. Turning in. Rana goes for the slog sweep, but mistimed. In the air, but doesn't have the distance. Rana going for a poor-shot choice, giving RCB a sniff in
full on middle. Nudged off the back foot to midwicket
back of a length outside off. Stays on the back foot and nudges a late guide past Bharat's left. Third man, Chahal, runs around to cut it off
slower ball, short ball. Rana prepares to pull but through the shot too early. Hits the arm
good length outside off stump. And cut to deep point for a single
full and wide outside off. Comes down the track and slaps it square. Toe-ended to third man
good length outside off from around the stumps. Tapped to cover point, loud 'no' for the single
full on off, and nudged off the front foot to midwicket
fullish, on middle. Flicked off the back foot to deep midwicket. Just one, will keep strike
full on middle. Down on one knee, and swept to deep backward square leg for a single
good length, outside leg. Stays on the back foot and taps it to square leg for a single
full on middle. Googly turning across. Nudged to cover for one
full on middle. Defended to midwicket and off they go for a single
lbw appeal but not given. Full just outside leg stump. Looks to slog leg side. Misses
full outside off. Slower ball. Slugged to long on for a single
full outside leg, and going down the leg side. Team hundred as Narine offers no shot
uses the width of the crease. Slower ball, full outside off. But Narine is up to the challenge. Through the slog a bit too early but still has enough power to clear long off! One-hand six
slower ball. Good length, very wide outside off. Left alone
makes full use of the short side! Full around the stumps, on his toes, and slogged over deep midwicket!
slower ball, short ball, but Narine was expecting that length. Stays on the back foot, swivels, and then clubs a pull to fine leg for six!
good length just outside off. He clatters a shot down the ground, past Christian's left hand. Single to long on
Rana around the stumps. Good length on middle, and worked to midwicket

another short ball, and tickled behind to the keeper! That is 32 wickets for Harshal this season, and he ties with Bravo for most wickets in an IPL season. Iyer pulls at this short ball on middle - which is also a slower ball - but gets a touch of glove behind to the keeper, as Bharat dives to his right to grab at that
punches this fullish ball outside off to the man at cover
gets an inside edge as he looks to drive at this full ball on off. The ball trickles toward square leg, as Bharat gives the chase
short delivery pitching on middle, and taking off from the surface while angling down leg. Wide called, as it was too wide and too high
nudges this full ball on off to mid-off's right, as Harshal goes for change of pace again
slower ball, and full and outside off. Presents the full face of the bat to drive to deep point
full ball just outside off, and pushed down to long-on
another reverse-sweep, and another boundary! Full ball on middle, and Rana utilises the angle from around the wicket expertly by getting ready to deposit that early again
taps back this full ball on off

dropped by Shahbaz after running and diving forward at fine leg! Just looks to guide that full-toss on middle and leg by simply keeping a horizontal bat. It takes to top edge instead, and flies to fine leg. He smiles after the escape
nudges this fullish ball on middle to the on side
reverse-sweeps this for six! The shorter boundary comes into play here. Rana is early into his shot to this full ball outside off, and capitalises on the man inside the circle at short third man
good length ball outside off, and clipped to long-on's left with a little swivel
goes down to sweep this fullish ball on middle, but the ball turns into him and strikes his body
very full on middle and leg, and tapped toward cover. Bharat scampers to his left to stop a single
short and wide of off, and cut away to deep point
pulls his length back to go on a good length on off, and it turns away a touch. Flicked to fine leg
slogs at this full ball on middle, and swings that to deep midwicket after going down on his back knee
very full and just outside off. Tapped to point
Kohli at cover dives to his left, but the ball just evades him! Rana skipped down to this full ball outside off and opened the bat face to lift that, and managed a single to deep cover in the end
turns away that good length ball outside off to the right of short fine leg
sweeps this full ball outside leg to short fine leg. Another dot in the over
good length ball on off, and straightening after pitching. Clipped to midwicket
full and straight on off. Blocked back off the front foot
Maxwell dives to his right, but can't get a hand, as Iyer drives at that full ball outside off to long-off

the googly now! Huge appeal for leg before, but not given. Kohli reviews. The ball strikes Tripathi's front pad as he looks to jab at that but is beaten. Hits him just above his knee after pitching on a good length outside off, and turning sharply into him. No inside edge is confirmed by UltraEdge. And replays show the ball would have taken the leg stump. So Tripathi departs, and Royal Challengers pinch one on the review
fullish ball and just outside off. Punched to deep point from deep in his crease
goes down on his back knee, and sweeps this full ball on middle to fine leg, with his front leg almost outside leg stump
comes down the track, and nudges this full ball outside off to long-off with the full face of the bat
tossed up, and that is very full on middle. Pushed to long-on after clearing his front leg
pretty full on his pads, and clipped to long-on after playing like a half-volley
shot of the day so far! Simply leans into this full ball in the slot and a touch wide of off, and goes down on his back knee, to present the full face of the bat and loft that over cover for four
opens the bat face to dab that back of a length ball outside off, but finds point
slower ball, and full and wide of off. Nudges that to deep point
pushes at this full ball just outside off, and plays that aerially just to the right of the man at extra cover. Two runs to deep point

sends that up milessss in the air, and de Villiers pouches it moving to his right from mid-on! Gill is foxed by the slower ball - an offcutter - which is full on middle, and looks to check his shot last moment. He makes room to try and send that into space, but ends up splicing it with his bottom hand off. That hung up in night sky for ages, before finally landing in de Villiers' hands to leave Kohli pumped
Starts with a slower ball, and very full on off. Driven to deep point by opening the bat face
very full on off, and clipped to fine leg again. Again the fielder at square leg has to scamper to his right to cut that off
full-toss on middle, and driven to mid-on between the non-striker and the stumps. de Villiers there fumbles while collecting on the bounce to his right, but no extra run conceded
nails this yorker on leg. Iyer backs away early, but can only jam this back to the bowler
yorker on middle, and swinging into him. Flicked to mid-on while playing from leg stump
Padikkal at point dives to his right, and saves three runs! Short and wide of off, and Gill cuts that forcefully, only for the fielder to intervene
flicked toward fine leg, and Shahbaz runs to his right to keep that to two. Full ball on off, and angling, as Gill clips firmly with the closed face of the bat
slower ball, and pretty full on off. Dabs that to point to complete another quick single
takes a gentle step down the wicket to this good length ball on off, and punches it to the man at extra cover
taps this full ball on off toward cover, and sets off for a rapid run
off the bottom edge, but Gill will take it! Again makes room and comes down the pitch, but gets an edge to this fullish ball outside leg. The keeper sticks out his left glove but doesn't get a hand
rams that pull into the deep midwicket fence! Garton now goes short of a length on leg, an despite that being a slower ball, he absolutely creamed that pull
crashes that between the non-striker and the stumps! Skips down the pitch again, and makes room to slam that full ball just outside off with a horizontal bat
slower ball, and full length on middle. Chipped to mid-on aerially, but safely
dances around with his back leg to try and distract the bowler, but can only squeeze that very full ball outside off to point
shortish in length outside off, and cut to deep point
taps at this full delivery outside off to point, and sets off for a run. There is a throw from the man there, and it hits the stumps. But the ball ricochets, and allows a run anyway
cuts away this back of a length ball outside off to deep point
goes down the track and makes a touch of room, but can only push that full-toss on off to mid-off

that lands on the shed, and goes out of the ground beyond the long leg fence! Garton bowls short of a length on middle and off, and Iyer pulls from deep in his crease to fire the first six of the match. That came with a good sound off the bat too
change of pace again, and this time he pushes at that full ball outside off to the man at extra cover
slower ball, and full and wide of off. He presents the full face of the bat to drive that to point, and can't find the gap
crunches this full delivery outside off to the right of mid-off, as Kohli runs and stops that rather quickly
strikes his front pad as Iyer misses his flick to this fullish ball on middle, which is angling. The ball trickles to the off side, and allows a leg-bye
pitches short of a leg on leg, and Gill skips to flick that to fine leg
bowls pretty full on off, as Iyer jabs forward to mid-off with the open face of the bat
Chahal at short fine leg slides to his left to stop that, as Gill clips this fullish ball on middle behind the wicket. Qquick single taken
pushes at this full delivery on off, and plays to mid-off
